CHIPTUNA is a free retro sound effect generator for game developers, tinkerers, and chiptune fans. Hit Random to roll a fresh sound biased toward classic game shapes, or reach for a preset (pickup, shoot, explosion, powerup, hit, jump, select) to get variations on a theme. Mutate nudges every parameter a little for a new take on the same character, and per-slider locks let you freeze the parts you like while everything else keeps rolling. Under the hood are three sections (amp, pitch, and wave) each with its own envelope and LFO, morphing across the eight PICO-8 waveforms, plus a hand-rolled stereo reverb that takes a sound from dry mono to wide and spacious with one knob. Every sound is captured in a compact seed string you can copy, share, and paste back to reproduce it sample for sample, and when you are happy you can export a real Ogg Vorbis file straight from the browser. No install, no account, no ads: just open it and start making noise.
